blocks.raw: <WikiCalloutBox title="Rolling Sphere Radii (IEC 62305-3)" variant="info">Each protection level has a defined radius: **Level I = 20 m**, **Level II = 30 m**, **Level III = 45 m**, **Level IV = 60 m**. These radii determine the maximum distance from air terminals at which protection extends. In the Philippines, Level II and III systems are most common for commercial and residential buildings.</WikiCalloutBox>

blocks.raw:
<Example title="Ground Resistance Calculation">
**Scenario:** Metro Manila building with clay soil (resistivity 120 ohms·m), requires ≤10 ohms.

**Rod specification:** Two 3.5 m deep copper rods, 16 mm diameter, spaced 5.5 m apart (1.5× length rule).

**Calculation:**
- Single rod: R = ρ / L = 120 / 3.5 ≈ 34 ohms
- Two rods in parallel (approximate): R_parallel ≈ 34 / 2 = 17 ohms (overestimate; actual lower due to spacing reduction factor)
- With spacing factor k ≈ 0.6: R ≈ 17 × 0.6 ≈ 10.2 ohms (marginal)

**Improvement:** Add horizontal strap or ring conductor buried 1 m deep around rod cluster.
- Ring adds ~5 ohms capacitance (parallel path)
- Final system: R ≈ (10.2 × 5) / (10.2 + 5) ≈ 3.4 ohms (well below 10 ohm target)

**Test:** Verify with clamp-on tester at three points on system perimeter; all ≤10 ohms confirms compliance.
</Example>

blocks.raw: <WikiCalloutBox title="PD 1096 Requirements for Tall Buildings (UK Standard, Reference)" variant="warning">PD 1096 does not specify LPS; PEC references NFPA 780 (45m RSM radius) for all structures. For tall residential towers and commercial buildings exceeding 50 m in Philippine cities, use RSM with Level II protection minimum. Mesh conductor spacing ≤10 m required on roofs of structures >50 m to ensure comprehensive coverage and current distribution redundancy.</WikiCalloutBox>
